sources.verified: Author and publisher records verify On the Size of Weights for Threshold Gates, SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics 7 (1994), pp484–492. The local PDF is a 13-page author version, not the 9-page journal typesetting.
sources.mathematical_scope: The point-flip test constructions were inspected. The audit supplies explicit proofs of the Fourier setup, growth by averaging, every-weight dominance, product and sharper asymptotic expansion, without assuming the article theorem.

sources.verified: Primary publisher record confirms Alon and Vu, Anti-Hadamard Matrices, Coin Weighing, Threshold Gates, and Indecomposable Hypergraphs, JCTA 79 (1997), pp133–160; the abstract identifies an extension of Hastad’s construction.
sources.limit: Broader article theorems and historical priority were not re-audited and are not inputs to the proof.
